title: Marketing Operations Manager (with Marketo)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

We’re seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to own and evolve our Marketo ecosystem. This role will take full responsibility for the platform, improve how it’s structured and used, and partner closely with our Marketing team and Salesforce Admin to drive scalable, reliable execution. This person will immediately stabilize and improve the system, while enabling others on the team to operate more effectively.

We expect East/West Coast/etc. work hours.


As Our Marketing Operations Manager, You Will:

  • Own day-to-day execution in Marketo (email sends, landing pages, forms, smart campaigns, programs, UTM parameters)
  • Drive Marketo platform architecture, governance, and best practices
  • Improve program structure and operational standards
  • Design and maintain scalable campaign frameworks
  • Optimize lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and sync with Salesforce
  • Act as the primary Marketo expert and point of escalation
  • Partner with the Salesforce Admin on data model, integrations, and automation
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and technical debt
  • Support and mentor other Marketo users on the team
  • Contribute to longer-term marketing operations strategy and tooling decisions
  • Manage the integrations of additional tools like On24, ZoomInfo and other items in the MarTech stack
  • Maintain database health through smart list logic, segmentation, and deduplication strategies.
  • Track KPIs for campaign performance, conversion rates, and lead funnel progression.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to marketing automation workflows and program efficiency.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in a marketing operations or marketing automation role.
  • Proficient in Marketo ; Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) preferred. Hands-on, end-to-end usage as well as administrative support are equally critical. Experience with HubSpot is also preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM ; admin experience highly desirable.

title: Brand Manager / Brand Development Leader - Casino slots LATAM market
description:
Please note that we are only considering candidates with proven experience in the LATAM market and experience working with Casino Slots products. Please send you CV in English.


Art of Spin is an ambitious iGaming startup within the Altenar ecosystem. We are building the brand from scratch and planning an aggressive international expansion with a portfolio of innovative slot games and unique mechanics.

Our goal is to become a recognized industry player by leveraging creativity and virality — succeeding where competitors rely primarily on massive marketing budgets.


Your Mission

To take the Art of Spin brand from “unknown” to a top-of-mind choice for operators and players, starting with the LATAM market and expanding into Asia and the United States.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Building the brand foundation: Development and implementation of the brand book and corporate website. The website must include a functional Client Hub with technical specifications (RTP, volatility) and marketing assets for partners.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy: Development and execution of launch plans for specific regions (especially Brazil and Mexico), including localization of game content to align with cultural specifics of the markets.
  • B2B promotion and networking: Active LinkedIn development: lead generation, publishing news about signed contracts and game launches. Working with aggregators and direct outreach to operators. Preparation for participation in key exhibitions (ICE, SiGMA).
  • B2C marketing and virality: Identifying and executing bold and unconventional promotional ideas with viral potential. Building and managing a network of streamers (from micro-influencers to major stars) and affiliates. Managing social media campaigns (TikTok, Instagram Reels) to showcase gameplay and big wins.
  • Creative leadership: Providing deep context, strong hooks, and detailed briefs for the design and animation teams.


Candidate Requirements:


  • Deep expertise in iGaming: Minimum 5–10 years of experience in the industry; strong understanding of the entire ecosystem (provider — aggregator — operator — affiliate — player).
  • Knowledge of the LATAM market: Understanding of regional specifics, popular mechanics, traffic costs, and player preferences in Latin America (proven case studies in this region will be considered a strong advantage).
  • Startup mindset: Willingness to work within limited budgets, focusing on efficient organic growth strategies instead of expensive traditional campaigns.
  • Hands-on approach: At the initial stage, readiness to independently lead key processes (strategy, networking, creative briefs), with gradual team building of 3 specialists (SMM, commercial, design).
  • Creative drive: Ability not just to follow a plan, but to actively push the market and the team forward with bold ideas.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to build an international brand from scratch within a dynamic startup environment.
  • Work in a distributed international team (Cyprus, Malta).
  • High flexibility in decision-making.
  • Minimal corporate bureaucracy.
  • Real ownership and impact from day one.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

The Blockchain Product Manager is responsible for driving the day-to-day management of one of teams in the blockchain space. The project partners with the leading protocols to build whatever on-chain interaction they require that may include custody, staking, and governance support. This role requires a combination of technical understanding, business acumen, and leadership skills to build new asset support, manage a backlog of features and maintenance improvements, and think strategically about scaling the way we work. 

Technical Skills:

  • Independently define the requirements and roadmap, collaborating closely with an agile scrum team on blockchain integrations.
  • Proactively research protocol integrations with emerging blockchains, developing on-chain solutions that drive value for protocol foundations and institutional investors.

Complexity and Impact of Work:

  • Lead the blockchain team in day-to-day operations and drive cross-team initiatives, ensuring alignment with project goals and ownership of your team and their focus area.
  • Work closely with sales, design, and engineering - set the pace, drive projects forward and unblock the team. Write high quality PRDs that are clearly written and easy to understand.

Organizational Knowledge:

  • Understand the requirements that span across departments including compliance, legal, and operations to ensure we’re building the right product or service and escalating the potential impact to the appropriate stakeholders and and your managers when appropriate. 

Communication and Influence:

  • Educate your scrum team on needs from external protocols teams.
  • Communicate the roadmap clearly and persuasively across stakeholders.
  • Adapt communication both internally and externally in an effective manner. Explain and convince others the need to adapt or change processes, policies, structures, and methods to deliver their goals.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

  • You have 4-6 years of relevant product management experience. Experience with blockchain and web3 companies not required.
  • You have experience in driving and managing complex projects across multiple teams, demonstrating exceptional leadership and problem-solving skills.
  • You have a background in engineering, equipping you with the acumen to effectively collaborate with technical teams to solve problems.

  • You are autonomous, with the ability to make informed decisions that align with our strategic goals.
  • You are deeply invested in optimizing the end-user experience and leveraging it to create business value.
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • Experience with finance, Crypto / Blockchain
  • You have a background in the world of finance.


Soft Skills 

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.
  • High engagement, self starter with a problem-solving mindset.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);

  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.

  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Um especialista sênior que liderou a criação e gestão dos pipelines de dados que alimentam os modelos analíticos do projeto. description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors Compensation SR
description:
Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essas vagas são para você ! ✨

  • Consultor(a) SAP SuccessFactors Compensation SR


Sobre a oportunidade:

  • Atuar em projetos de implementação e/ou rollout do módulo Compensation do SAP SuccessFactors, do Blueprint ao Go-live/Hypercare.
  • Conduzir workshops de levantamento de requisitos (AS-IS/TO-BE) com RH e TI para desenho do processo de recrutamento e seleção.
  • Elaborar desenho de solução e documentação funcional (ex.: mapeamentos, decisões, regras e fluxos do processo seletivo).
  • Configurar e parametrizar o Recruiting conforme escopo do projeto, incluindo: job requisitions e templates de requisição; processos seletivos, estágios e status; formulários de candidatura e campos customizados; workflows de aprovação, e-mails e notificações; regras de elegibilidade e roteamento de candidatos; Apoiar o desenho e execução de testes (SIT/UAT), incluindo preparação de cenários, suporte a usuários-chave, registro de evidências e correção de defeitos.
  • Apoiar cutover e atividades de go-live, garantindo prontidão do processo (configurações finais, validações e comunicações de mudança).
  • Realizar troubleshooting de processos, regras e possíveis impactos de integrações relacionadas ao Recruiting, em conjunto com times técnicos quando necessário; Produzir e manter documentação do projeto (roteiros de teste, guias rápidos, materiais de treinamento e apoio à adoção).
  • Orientar e treinar key users, recrutadores e gestores durante o projeto, apoiando a gestão de mudanças.
  • Interagir com áreas de negócio, TI e fornecedores para alinhar dependências, riscos e decisões de desenho.
  • Garantir aderência do Recruiting às políticas e processos de RH do cliente e às melhores práticas SAP.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com SAP SuccessFactors – Compensation, com atuação relevante em projetos de implementação/rollout;
  • Conhecimento sólido em configuração do Compensation: planos (merit, bonus, LTIP), eligibility, guidelines, proration, workflows e regras de cálculo;
  • Experiência com levantamento de requisitos e desenho de processos de compensação e remuneração;
  • Vivência com testes (SIT/UAT), suporte a usuários-chave e tratativa de defeitos;
  • Familiaridade (ao menos funcional) com integrações do SuccessFactors (ex.: Integration Center, APIs, conectores) e capacidade de apoiar análise de falhas;
  • Capacidade de elaborar documentação funcional/técnica (solution design, mapeamentos, roteiros e evidências);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, organização e trabalho em equipe.


Desejável:

  • Certificação SAP SuccessFactors Compensation;
  • Conhecimento em outros módulos (ex.: Employee Central, PMGM, Variable Pay);
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado;
  • Participação em projetos de integração Compensation × PMGM e Compensation × EC;
  • Experiência com LTIP (Long Term Incentive Plans) e planos complexos de remuneração variável;
  • Habilidade para conduzir workshops e ministrar treinamentos (funcionais e para usuários).

Junte-se a nós e ajude-nos a humanizar o mundo através da tecnologia!

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.


Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours


Communication : Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.


Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).


Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).


This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.


Responsibilities:


  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.


Required Skills:


  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with Azure AI services or Microsoft AI Foundry.
  • Strong experience designing API-driven integrations and distributed automation architectures.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise data platforms, with a preference for Databricks.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and production-ready AI automation solutions.


Preferred Skills:


  • Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-agent workflows or human-in-the-loop automation systems.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Product Owner (PO) - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você:

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Auxílio creche

- Seguro de vida

- Acesso a plataforma de apoio psicossocial

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

  • Atuar como PO no dia a dia do time, garantindo clareza das demandas e sua correta priorização.
  • Conduzir e participar de cerimônias ágeis: refinamento, planning, daily, review e retrospectiva.
  • Escrever e detalhar user stories, critérios de aceite e casos de uso.
  • Acompanhar o andamento das entregas, riscos, impedimentos e evolução dos sprints.
  • Garantir comunicação contínua com o PM, trazendo visibilidade sobre status, decisões, gaps e eventos relevantes.
  • Apoiar na gestão e organização do backlog, mantendo-o atualizado, coerente e priorizado conforme estratégia.
  • Coordenar ou apoiar atividades relacionadas ao desenvolvimento do produto, incluindo alinhamentos técnicos e operacionais.
  • Monitorar métricas do time (velocity, burndown, lead time, capacity etc.) e reportar andamento de sprints.
  • Apoiar estruturação das user stories da equipe tendo em vista o roadmap do projeto.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou função equivalente em equipes ágeis.

title: SAP Specialist
description:
SAP S/4HANA FICO AMS Consultant

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2/L3 production support for SAP S/4HANA Finance (FICO) modules.
  • Manage incidents, service requests, and problem tickets using ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent solutions for recurring system issues.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities with finance teams.
  • Handle critical finance incidents and communicate updates to business and IT stakeholders.
  • Support and troubleshoot SAP FI modules including:
  • General Ledger (FI-GL)
  • Accounts Payable (FI-AP)
  • Accounts Receivable (FI-AR)
  • Asset Accounting (FI-AA)
  • Bank Accounting and Electronic Bank Statements
  • Provide support for Controlling (CO) processes during closing cycles including:
  • Material Ledger
  • Cost Center Accounting
  • Profit Center Accounting
  • Allocations and settlements
  • Analyze integration issues between finance and logistics processes such as FI-MM and FI-SD integrations.
  • Deliver minor system enhancements and configuration updates within the AMS support scope.
  • Prepare functional documentation, test cases, and support user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Participate in change management and release processes.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation aligned with audit and compliance standards.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–10 years of experience in SAP FICO consulting or application support.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance modules.
  • Proven experience in Application Management Support (AMS) or production support environments.
  • Solid knowledge of FI modules including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting, and Bank Accounting.
  • Working knowledge of SAP CO processes, especially Material Ledger and month-end close activities.
  • Experience handling incident management, problem management, and service requests.
  • Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Understanding of Brazil localization, taxes, and statutory financial requirements is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
  • SAP S/4HANA Finance certification is a plus.

title: Business Development Manager – Advertisers & Agencies (LATAM)
description:
Company Description

Orange Storm is a leading venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA, and Barcelona, Spain. Our integrated ecosystem includes a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and an AI-driven analytics platform, empowering publishers and advertisers to make smarter decisions and drive revenue growth. Our global and diverse team thrives in a culture of trust, ownership, and continuous learning. We prioritize collaboration, agile execution, and innovation to deliver scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the dynamic AdTech industry.


Role Description

We are looking for a proactive Business Development Manager based in Argentina to help expand our partnerships with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM.

This role focuses on building a strong pipeline through outbound outreach and industry networking. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys identifying new partners, starting conversations, and turning connections into long-term collaborations.

You will work closely with internal teams to introduce our advertising solutions and onboard new partners.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify and connect with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM
  • Conduct daily outreach through LinkedIn, email, Telegram communities, and other networking channels
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline
  • Schedule meetings and introduce our advertising solutions to potential partners
  • Develop relationships with media buyers, agencies, and advertiser teams
  • Support the onboarding process for new partners and coordinate internally with operations teams
  • Maintain long-term relationships and help grow advertiser spend over time
  • Explore creative ways to find partners, including industry communities, social platforms, and events

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in AdTech, performance marketing, affiliate marketing, or digital advertising
  • Strong outbound sales or partnership development mindset
  • Comfortable doing high-volume outreach and networking
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Based in Argentina
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Spanish + Portuguese bilingual
  • Experience working with advertisers or performance agencies
  • Existing connections with LATAM advertisers or media buying teams
  • Russian language skills are a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based commission
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to grow with an international AdTech company
  • Direct exposure to the global digital advertising ecosystem

Ideal Candidate

Someone who:

  • Enjoys building pipeline and starting new conversations
  • Is creative in finding potential partners and opportunities
  • Is proactive and comfortable reaching out to new people
  • Wants to grow in the AdTech and performance marketing industry

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: SAP SD Consultant
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled SAP SD Consultant with strong expertise in SAP ECC environments, business process analysis, and cross‑functional collaboration. The ideal candidate must be bilingual in English, possess hands‑on experience across the full lifecycle of SAP implementations, and be capable of supporting and optimizing Order‑to‑Cash (OTC) processes in a dynamic, global environment.


Key Responsibilities

SAP Functional Expertise

  • Participate in at least one full lifecycle SAP implementation (preferably in a business-facing role).
  • Configure, maintain, and enhance SAP SD and related peer applications.
  • Identify functional gaps and collaborate with technical teams to create and review functional specifications.
  • Support Product Supply requirements ensuring proper SAP configuration, development, and interface alignment (EDI, SAP PO, 3PL, etc.).
  • Work closely with business groups and developers to support, design, and enhance critical applications within SAP ECC 6.0 and integrated systems.

Business Process & System Analysis

  • Conduct business process analysis, documentation, and presentation.
  • Translate end-user requirements into detailed functional specifications.
  • Re-engineer business processes when necessary to drive efficiency.
  • Document process flows, requirements, design specifications, testing plans, and quality assurance outputs.
  • Coordinate and assist with system conversions and data migration activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) with the India SAP support team.
  • Collaborate with local and international teams across Order Management, Physical Distribution, and other functional areas.
  • Assist key users in managing Work Requests (developments, enhancements, production support) including:
  • Initial assessment
  • Determining need for internal/external assistance
  • Following standard procedures for cross-team collaboration

Systems Support & Testing

  • Troubleshoot and resolve transactional issues with internal users, customers, and EDI vendors.
  • Lead and participate in integrated system testing ensuring business requirements are met.
  • Conduct and coordinate user training, documentation, and validation activities.
  • Ensure high-quality procedures, processes, and guidelines across deliverables.

Project & Work Management

  • Manage project-related tasks, work request planning, and scheduling.
  • Assist reporting managers with work prioritization and status updates in the Work Request Database.
  • Support development, enhancement, and production support efforts across business-critical SAP functions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bilingual English – mandatory.
  • Proven experience in SAP SD with strong knowledge of Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes.
  • Experience with SAP ECC 6.0, EDI integrations, SAP Process Orchestration, and related interfaces.
  • Solid background in system analysis, configuration, and functional specification development.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Experience working in self-directed environments and leading cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex system issues and guide users through process and system changes.
  • Strong documentation skills (requirements, specs, testing, QA).

Working Time

  • Must be available to work aligned with Client EST hours , considering the BRT time zone .

title: Business Development Manager/Director
description:
PingPong is on a mission to digitize trade, simplifying global growth for businesses. With $300B+ in payments processed, we're one of the world’s leading cross-border platforms – and we’re just getting started.

PingPong currently has 38 offices in 15 countries and over 1,500 employees. Our international presence helps businesses solve complex payment needs in every major economy across all time zones.


Now, we're scaling and looking for a BD Manager/Director to own the strategy, pipeline, and partnerships that will power our next phase of growth.


WHAT’S THE CHALLENGE?


You will take ownership for growing our customers and revenue in the region. You’ll land high-impact deals with banks, fintechs, platforms and enterprises. You’ve got the commercial sharpness to close complex deals.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH


You’ll partner closely with our local Compliance, Product, Marketing and operations teams to build a cohesive user journey that delivers the right product to the right users, at the right time. You’ll also collaborate with colleagues across US, EU and other regions and with Group HQ teams.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING


  • Build and execute our BD strategy across the LATAM with a focus on financial institutions, platforms and enterprise clients.
  • Maintain a high-quality pipeline across identified target verticals, focusing on high-impact deals, and think through supporting business development strategies.
  • Own the full sales cycle for closing new partners – from sourcing and qualification to leading the definition of the solution for the partner and negotiating the commercials, all the way through to go-live.
  • Pitch our API-first platform, solving real cross-border pain points.
  • Lead commercial and legal negotiations with C-level execs.
  • Work to improve our go-to-market approach, refining messaging, pricing strategy, and pitch materials based on feedback from partners and insights about competitors.
  • Collaborate internally, sharing feedback and insights from the LATAM market to product teams and senior management to inform roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Continuously refine our go-to-market playbook based on what works.
  • Be the voice of the UK market internally – and help drive what comes next.


WHAT YOU BRING


  • Track record in BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales in fintech or financial services:
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions or regulated entities
  • Fluency in the world of payments, FX, embedded finance, or APIs.
  • Strategic thinker, hands-on doer, data-driven operator.
  • Able to speak the language of product, compliance, and commercial teams.


WHO YOU ARE


  • Educated with a relevant degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
  • Customer-focused, you can’t imagine working in any other way, and it’s the only way to achieve our goals.
  • Equally at home in both strategic planning and hands-on execution, ideally with experience in start-up/scale-up as well as larger organisations.
  • Ability to drill down, persistent and never-give-up spirit.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop and execute high-impact business development strategies.
  • Strong consultative sales approach and experience negotiating with enterprise C-level executives.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills – able to influence internal and external stakeholders


PingPong is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer with a global culture that embraces diversity.

  • We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior QA Automation Engineer with 5+ years of experience in quality assurance automation testing to join and focus on our U.S. client's automation needs. Primary duties include testing all new feature enhancements, maintaining test cases and overall regression testing of the application. This key individual should have experience making decisions and working both independently and as part of a small, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.

Our client provides business-automating enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Create and execute test plans for existing products and features
  • Establish test automation priorities, processes, and capabilities
  • Develop and execute manual as well as automated tests
  • Evaluate requirements and acceptance criteria, as well as build scenarios, ensuring full traceability
  • Work with the development team early in the software development lifecycle to define testing strategies and protocols for new features


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in quality assurance automation testing, including functional, bug verification, regression, user acceptance, and user experience testing, including testing services
  • Experience with automation tools, such as Tosca, Selenium, and Playwright
  • Strong experience with API testing and Postman
  • Experience testing REST-based services
  • Experience with project management tracking systems, such as Targetprocess
  • Excellent troubleshooting capabilities and problem-solving skills


Preferred Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry
  • Flutter Mobile app testing experience


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, YouTube, social, and other relevant channels.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2B SaaS organizations.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own:

  • Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
  • Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
  • Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
  • Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
  • Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.

title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)

Company : Elevated Tahoe Properties

Location : Remote


About Us

Elevated Tahoe Properties manages high-touch short-term rental and property portfolios focused on guest experience, operational excellence, and high-performing marketing that drives direct bookings. We’re hiring a proactive, creative, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our website, digital marketing, social media, and lead generation efforts.

Our Company Culture:

  • We are a fun, young company growing quickly
  • We value open communication and adding in humor whenever possible
  • Our team is self driven and empowered to handle their own responsibilities without being micromanaged
  • We inspire each other to become the best version of ourselves we can possibly become. 
  • We lead by example and use positive reinforcement to inspire others to strive for personal and professional greatness.

Role Summary

You will be responsible for helping us grow our online presence and increase direct vacation rental bookings through website updates, landing page creation, lead capture strategy, email marketing, and social media content support. This role requires strong design instincts, attention to detail, marketing experience, and a solid understanding of WordPress, Elementor, and basic website coding.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage and update our WordPress website using Elementor
  • Build and optimize landing pages designed to drive bookings and capture leads
  • Improve website layout, visuals, and user experience to support conversion goals
  • Help increase traffic to the website through organic and campaign-based marketing efforts
  • Develop compelling, conversion-focused copywriting that incorporates SEO best practices for all web and marketing assets
  • Edit and prepare social media content including short-form video, photos, graphics, and captions
  • Schedule and publish social media posts across relevant platforms
  • Monitor inbound leads and help organize follow-up and lead nurturing workflows
  • Create and manage nurture email campaigns for existing guests, past guests, and new leads
  • Support list building, audience segmentation, and email campaign improvements
  • Assist with marketing asset creation for promotions, campaigns, and seasonal offers
  • Maintain brand consistency across website pages, email marketing, and social media content
  • Collaborate with leadership on ideas to improve direct bookings, lead generation, and guest engagement

Qualifications


  • Proven experience in digital marketing, website management, or lead generation
  • Strong hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor
  • Strong design skills with an eye for clean, polished, high-converting content
  • Experience editing social media video and photo content
  • Experience with email marketing platforms and nurture campaigns
  • Comfortable creating landing pages and understanding basic conversion strategy
  • Decent to strong website coding basics, including familiarity with HTML/CSS and light troubleshooting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple moving pieces
  • Able to work independently, take initiative, and bring creative solutions to the table
  • Familiarity with Asana or similar project management tools

Non‑Negotiable Requirements

  • Reliable backup power (UPS or generator) to prevent downtime during outages
  • Dual monitors for efficient multitasking
  • Backup internet (secondary wired connection or mobile hotspot) with stable speeds
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace and dependable computer 

Preferred

  • Experience with the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) or similar creative tools
  • Strong video editing proficiency for creating engaging short-form content
  • Deep understanding of social media marketing trends, algorithms, and best practices
  • Experience working with hospitality, vacation rentals, real estate, or travel brands

Required Days/Hours

  • Monday - Friday 8AM to 5PM Pacific Time (1 hour unpaid Lunch Break)


Compensation Target:

$950 per month + monthly KPI bonus / 40 hours per week — salary negotiable based on experience.

What We Offer

  • Remote role supporting a growing vacation rental and hospitality brand
  • Opportunity to directly impact bookings, lead generation, and brand growth
  • Creative, collaborative team environment with room to contribute ideas and improve systems


How to Apply (only email applications will be considered)


Email :

Subject : The Marketing & Website Coordinator Your Team Needs


Include:

  • Your Resume/CV
  • ONE OF (listed in order of preference):
  • A link to your personal portfolio website
  • A comprehensive PDF format portfolio document
  • At list of at least 5 links of design and marketing work you’ve completed
  • Pre-Screening Form:
  • Internet Speed Verification:

Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the speed test results.

  • DISC Assessment:

  Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the DISC assessment results graph.

  • A 2–3 minute video that includes:

-Brief intro and summary of your experience

-Why you’re the ideal candidate for this position

-Your top 3 skills that make you an excellent marketing and design coordinator


﻿Only applicants who follow these instructions exactly and demonstrate strong attention to detail will be considered.


Thank you and we look forward to working with you!


~ Elevated Tahoe Properties Team

title: Especialista em SAP S/4HANA e Inteligência Artificial
description:

O Grupo Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 67.000 colaboradores e receita anual de aproximadamente €10 bilhões, atuando em 61 países sob duas marcas: Atos, voltada para serviços, e Eviden, focada em produtos.

Reconhecido como o número 1 na Europa em cibersegurança, computação em nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo Atos está comprometido com um futuro seguro e descarbonizado, oferecendo soluções completas e personalizadas, impulsionadas por inteligência artificial, para todos os setores.

O propósito do Grupo Atos é ajudar a desenhar o futuro do espaço da informação. Sua expertise e serviços apoiam o desenvolvimento do conhecimento, da educação e da pesquisa com uma abordagem multicultural, contribuindo para o avanço da excelência científica e tecnológica.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Native Teams is a global platform for work payments and employment. Beyond managing payroll, compliance, and taxes, we integrate financial tools to maximise the value of every work payment, worldwide.


We are expanding our global team and looking for a Business Development Manager to bring their wider knowledge and help us get our product and service more widely known and used.


In this role, you will play a key role in driving new business and revenue growth by managing the full sales cycle from outbound outreach to discovery, solution design, negotiation, and closing. You will work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs, educate them on Native Teams' solutions, and guide them through the decision-making and onboarding process. Your goal is to acquire new customers and expand revenue within assigned markets and ICPs.


Would you like to take on a new challenge in the field of sales in a successful, fast-growing global start-up?


Location: Remote

Salary range: Flexible


Key Responsibilities


Outbound & Pipeline Generation

  • Proactively identify and engage prospective clients through outbound outreach, networking, events, and other channels.
  • Execute outbound strategies tailored to defined ICPs and market segments.
  • Research accounts for understanding business context, hiring plans, and potential use cases.


Inbound Handling

  • Take qualified inbound requests and convert them into active opportunities.
  • Respond promptly and professionally in line with internal SLAs.
  • Run a structured qualification to assess fit and readiness.


Discovery & Consultative Selling

  • Conduct high-quality discovery calls to understand client goals, blockers, compliance considerations, and service requirements.
  • Educate prospects on how Native Teams supports global employment, payroll, and work payments.
  • Present tailored solutions, product overviews, and value propositions to multiple stakeholders.


Solution Design & Pricing

  • Prepare proposals, pricing scenarios, and competitive a/b options in line with commercial guidelines.
  • Guide clients on hiring models (EoR, Contractor of Record, etc.) and explain operational processes.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure feasibility for legal, product, and finance-related questions.


Negotiation & Closing

  • Manage contract negotiations and commercial discussions through to signature.
  • Navigate procurement timelines, internal approvals, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Close new business and achieve monthly/quarterly revenue targets.


Pipeline Ownership & Forecasting

  • Maintain an up-to-date sales pipeline with accurate stage management and forecasting.
  • Log all activities, updates, and communication history in the CRM.
  • Prioritize high-impact opportunities while balancing follow-ups and nurturing.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Product teams to ensure a smooth client transition post-close.
  • Relay client feedback to internal stakeholders to support product and process improvements.
  • Represent the sales voice in outbound campaigns, ICP targeting, and revenue initiatives.


Market Feedback & Learning

  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitive offerings, and compliance developments.
  • Share insights from the market to improve positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.



Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Experience in outbound sales, B2B sales, or full-cycle sales roles.
  • Strong communication and client-facing presentation skills.
  • Confident running discovery calls, demos, and negotiations.

Benefits


  • Dynamic and interesting work in an early-stage, funded startup.
